items.source: Implementations of AggregationOperationContext retain their FieldLookupPolicy. If no policy is specified, then lookup defaults to FieldLookupPolicy.strict().
items.translation: 实现AggregationOperationContext的实例会保留其FieldLookupPolicy。如果未指定策略，则查找默认采用FieldLookupPolicy.strict()。

items.source: This toggle allows the context to use any given field name without checking for its existence. Typically, the AggregationOperationContext fails when referencing unknown fields, those that are not present in one of the previous stages or the input source, throughout the pipeline.
items.translation: 此开关允许 context 使用任意给定的字段名，而无需检查其是否存在。通常情况下，AggregationOperationContext 在引用未知字段时会失败，这些字段未在管道中的任何先前阶段或输入源中出现。
